Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 23 August 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, San Marcelino, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Narciso, San Felipe, Cabangan, Botolan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna, Quezon, Tarlac and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Cavite, Batangas, Pampanga, Bulacan and Zambales(Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
